newsitem.title: USA: Mohave 750 MW coal unit still off, start uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Mohave 750 MW coal unit still off, start uncertain.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Mohave coal-fired power plant in Nevada remains off line and there is no estimate yet for how long it will be shut, a spokesman for the plant said Thursday.
The unit, which tripped off Monday due to a boiler tube leak, had been expected to restart late Wednesday night, but the discovery of additional tube leaks led to the delay, the spokesman said.
The plant's other 750 MW unit was said to be operating normally.
Edison International's Southern California Edison Co is the majority owner and operator of the Mohave plant.
